title: Halberd of Vigilance

sources.title: Cleave
markers: | description = Swing your weapon in a large arc to attack up to 3 enemies at once. They each take half the damage your weapon usually deals.

sources.title: Lacerate
markers: | description = Slash at your target's vital points to make it {{SmCond|Bleeding|Bleed}}.

sources.title: Rush Attack
markers: | description = Charge forward and attack the first enemy in your way, possibly pushing them {{SmCond|Off Balance}}.

sources.title: Sentinel Weapon
markers: | summary = '''Sentinel Weapon''' is a passive feature that lets the wielder move earlier and pay closer attention to their surroundings.

sources.title: Adroit Reflexes
markers: | summary = '''Adroit Reflexes''' is a passive feature that enhances your counterattacks.

summary: A +2 halberd with 1d4 extra Force damage, +1 Initiative, advantage on Perception checks and advantage on Reaction attacks.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d10 + 2 Slashing plus Strength modifier, 8 ft melee reach. Martial, heavy, two-handed, and dippable.
fields.Cleave: With proficiency, Action once per Short Rest. Attack up to three non-allied creatures or objects in a 7 ft cone for half weapon damage. Flat bonuses such as Rage are not halved.
fields.Lacerate: With proficiency, Action once per Short Rest. Make a weapon attack. On hit, Constitution save against weapon-action DC +2 or Bleeding for 2 turns. The condition source lists Constructs, Elementals, Plants, Oozes and most Undead as immune, with Ghasts and Ghouls as exceptions.
fields.Rush Attack: With proficiency, Action once per Short Rest. Rush up to 30 ft and attack the first non-allied creature or object for 1d4 Piercing plus attack ability modifier. Strength save against weapon-action DC or Off Balance for 2 turns.
fields.Enchantment: +2 to attack and damage rolls, included in the listed damage.
fields.Force damage: Hits with this halberd deal 1d4 extra Force.
fields.Sentinel Weapon: +1 Initiative and advantage on Perception checks.
fields.Adroit Reflexes: Attack rolls you make as a Reaction have advantage.
fields.Base value: 960 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
